subject: general
question: Bending of light rays in the denser medium is termed as ________.
solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Refraction: The bending of a ray of light when it goes from one medium to another is called refraction of light.

 
 
• Refraction occurs when waves or rays of the light bend towards or away from the normal when they travel from one medium to another of a different density.
 
• When a light ray travels from a lighter to a denser medium, the light ray bends towards the normal.
 
• When a light ray travels from a denser to a lighter medium the light ray bend away from the normal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efd37994f741a0fa63e54e308057f447380a667e62a8987657c9fbefac81c01b.png] 

**EXPLANATION**__:

 
• Reflection: The phenomena in which light ray is sent back into the same medium from which it is coming, on interaction with boundary, is called reflection.
 
• Dispersion of light: The splitting of white light, when it passes through glass prism into its constituent spectrum is known as the dispersion of light.
 
• **Refraction**: The bending of light rays in the denser medium is termed as Refraction. So option 3 is correct.
 
• **Deflection**: There is no such phenomenon as a deflection of light.
